'''Bundles''' are {{MCW|Bundle|bundles}} that villagers sell already filled. The [[Farmer]] sells four kinds full of seeds, flowers or mushrooms, and the [[Engineer]] sells the Geothermal Bundle. Once emptied, they work like an ordinary bundle.

== Pre-filled bundles ==
All pre-filled bundles cost 1 [[Obol]] and can be bought 999 times before the villager restocks.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/farmer/1/seed_bundle.json}}</ref>

A Novice farmer offers 3 of its 5 trades, so not every farmer sells every bundle.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/trade_set/farmer/level_1.json}}</ref>

Notes:
* The Seed Bundle holds the pack's renamed wheat seeds ([[Wheat Grain]]) and beetroot seeds ([[Tomato Seeds]]).
* The Floral Bundle is exactly full: its 64 flowers fill a bundle's capacity.
* The lava buckets in the Geothermal Bundle stack up to 64, unlike normal lava buckets.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/armorer/5/lava_kit.json}}</ref> The bundle holds the blocks for filling cauldrons with lava from dripping [[Speleothem|speleothems]].

== Empty bundles ==
An empty bundle is crafted from 1 string above 1 rabbit hide, instead of the vanilla leather.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/bundle.json}}</ref> Empty bundles can also be found in village chests.
{{Recipes|Bundle}}

== Trivia ==
* The pre-filled bundles are vanilla bundles with a custom name and model. The Geothermal Bundle is a red bundle with no custom model, so it looks like a vanilla red bundle; its internal name is <code>lava_kit</code>.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/armorer/5/lava_kit.json}}</ref>
* The Mushy Bundle's internal name is <code>mushroom</code>.
